value.rationale: A sharp global structural classification of the maximum number of stationary points of the canonical geometric Rayleigh trial bound for all positive four-period modulations. It limits global optimization to at most two local maxima, and the bound is shown attained exactly. The finding is about optimization geometry, not a trivial parameter substitution or reuse of the known source uniqueness theorem.
